Opens Spotify\'s sign-in; the accounts here stay signed in
Signs this account out and opens Spotify\'s sign-in
Playback stops. Downloads and the listening history follow their own account; extensions keep running.
Its sign-in and web data are deleted from this phone, with its listening history. Its downloads are kept aside and come back if you add it again.
Each account stays signed in on this phone. Switching stops playback; downloads and the listening history follow their account; extensions keep running.

This phone\'s WebView keeps one account at a time: switching or adding an account signs this one out and opens Spotify\'s sign-in. Updating Android System WebView lets several accounts stay signed in.
